meta.name: adversarial-roleplay
meta.description: Tactic: Construct detailed hostile persona, attack artifact from that persona's perspective, record successful attack paths for aggregation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从敌对视角攻击你的系统，发现安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要模拟攻击者视角来发现系统安全弱点
copy.tagline_en: Attack your system from an adversarial perspective to uncover vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate an attacker's perspective to find security weaknesses

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会构建详细的有敌意的角色（包含背景、动机、专业领域），然后从该角色视角对指定工件发起攻击探测，记录成功攻击路径，并汇总不同角色的发现来识别漏洞。
howto.when: 当你需要模拟特定攻击者视角来测试工件安全性时触发，通常通过指定目标并允许 Claude 自主构造角色。

say.text: 扮演一个不满的内部员工，攻击我们新开发的支付系统，找安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会构建该角色并执行攻击。

say.text: 从一个国家背景的 APT 组织视角，对公司 API 进行渗透测试，记录发现。
say.note: 会从该角色视角执行探测并记录。

say.text: 假设你是追求利益的黑客，寻找网站中可被利用的 SQL 注入点。
say.note: 会构建角色并执行针对性攻击。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will construct detailed adversarial personas (with background, motivation, expertise) and attack a target artifact from each persona's perspective, record successful attack paths, and cross-reference findings across personas to identify vulnerabilities.
howto.when_en: This triggers when you need to test an artifact's security by simulating specific adversarial perspectives, typically by specifying a target and letting Claude construct personas.

say_en.text: Role-play a disgruntled employee and attack our new payment system for security flaws.
say_en.note: Claude builds the persona and executes attacks.

say_en.text: From a state-sponsored APT perspective, perform pen testing on our company API and record findings.
say_en.note: Executes probes from that persona's view.

say_en.text: Assume you are a profit-driven hacker looking for exploitable SQL injection points on our website.
say_en.note: Constructs persona and runs targeted probes.
